description: SJTUG request, repository, and object hotspots from privacy-reduced Caddy events stored in ClickHouse.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests represented by the selected 5-minute rollups.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(requests) AS Requests
FROM hotspot.repo_5m_totals
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
  AND $__conditionalAll(server IN (${server:singlequote}), $server)
  AND $__conditionalAll(repo IN (${repo:singlequote}), $repo)

panels.title: Response bytes
panels.description: Response body bytes for the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(bytes) AS Bytes
FROM hotspot.repo_5m_totals
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
  AND $__conditionalAll(server IN (${server:singlequote}), $server)
  AND $__conditionalAll(repo IN (${repo:singlequote}), $repo)

panels.title: Approximate unique clients
panels.description: Sum of per-bucket HMAC-pseudonymized client estimates; not a cross-range exact UV.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(unique_clients) AS Clients
FROM hotspot.repo_5m_totals
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
  AND $__conditionalAll(server IN (${server:singlequote}), $server)
  AND $__conditionalAll(repo IN (${repo:singlequote}), $repo)

SELECT sumIf(requests, status_class = '2xx') / greatest(sum(requests), 1) AS Share
FROM hotspot.repo_5m
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
  AND $__conditionalAll(server IN (${server:singlequote}), $server)
  AND $__conditionalAll(repo IN (${repo:singlequote}), $repo)

SELECT repo AS Repository, sum(requests) AS Requests
FROM hotspot.repo_5m_totals
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
  AND $__conditionalAll(server IN (${server:singlequote}), $server)
  AND $__conditionalAll(repo IN (${repo:singlequote}), $repo)
GROUP BY repo
ORDER BY Requests DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT repo AS Repository, sum(bytes) AS Bytes
FROM hotspot.repo_5m_totals
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
  AND $__conditionalAll(server IN (${server:singlequote}), $server)
  AND $__conditionalAll(repo IN (${repo:singlequote}), $repo)
GROUP BY repo
ORDER BY Bytes DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT bucket AS time, repo, sum(requests) / 300 AS Requests
FROM hotspot.repo_5m_totals
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
  AND $__conditionalAll(server IN (${server:singlequote}), $server)
  AND $__conditionalAll(repo IN (${repo:singlequote}), $repo)
GROUP BY time, repo
ORDER BY time, repo

SELECT bucket AS time, repo, max(request_time_p95) AS p95
FROM hotspot.repo_5m_totals
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
  AND $__conditionalAll(server IN (${server:singlequote}), $server)
  AND $__conditionalAll(repo IN (${repo:singlequote}), $repo)
GROUP BY time, repo
ORDER BY time, repo

panels.title: Rising repositories: last 15m versus prior 7d
panels.description: A score above 1 means the last 15 minutes are hotter than the average 15-minute period over the preceding seven days.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
current AS (
  SELECT repo, sum(requests) AS current_requests, sum(bytes) AS current_bytes
  FROM hotspot.repo_5m_totals
  WHERE bucket >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
    AND $__conditionalAll(server IN (${server:singlequote}), $server)
  GROUP BY repo
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT repo, sum(requests) / 671.0 AS baseline_requests
  FROM hotspot.repo_5m_totals
  WHERE bucket >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
    AND bucket < now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
    AND $__conditionalAll(server IN (${server:singlequote}), $server)
  GROUP BY repo
)
SELECT
  current.repo AS Repository,
  current_requests AS "Requests (15m)",
  current_bytes AS "Bytes (15m)",
  round(ifNull(baseline_requests, 0), 2) AS "Baseline / 15m",
  round(current_requests / greatest(ifNull(baseline_requests, 0), 1), 2) AS "Hotspot score"
FROM current
LEFT JOIN baseline USING repo
WHERE current_requests >= 100
  AND $__conditionalAll(current.repo IN (${repo:singlequote}), $repo)
ORDER BY "Hotspot score" DESC, current_requests DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Hot objects
panels.description: Paths are stored without query strings. Client estimates are pseudonymized and approximate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  repo AS Repository,
  path AS Path,
  sum(requests) AS Requests,
  sum(bytes) AS Bytes,
  sum(unique_clients) AS "Client estimates",
  sum(range_requests) AS "Range requests"
FROM hotspot.object_1h_totals
WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
  AND $__conditionalAll(server IN (${server:singlequote}), $server)
  AND $__conditionalAll(repo IN (${repo:singlequote}), $repo)
GROUP BY repo, path
ORDER BY Bytes DESC
LIMIT 100
